'''Davindra''' was the wife of [[Nevin]] a man from [[Ebou Dar]]. She is possibly of noble birth.
==Activities==
Nevin was killed by [[Beslan]] in a duel. Beslan so has to go to Davindra, his widow, and pay condolences. His mother the Queen [[Tylin]], advises Beslan to make it brief, otherwise he would "either have to marry her or kill her brothers".
